Goal: Create a polished presentation board of {argument name="app theme" default="number-play and logic puzzle"} app icon concepts, showing multiple alternative icon directions for a modern mobile app.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape canvas on a warm off-white background, minimal gallery-style spacing, soft shadows, premium design-review mockup aesthetic.

Header: Centered at the top, large elegant serif title text: {argument name="headline text" default="App Icon Concepts"}. Under it, a small uppercase tagline with spaced letters: {argument name="tagline text" default="PLAY WITH NUMBERS • LOGIC • PATTERN • RHYTHM • CURIOSITY"}. Use tiny colored dots between the words.

Layout: Arrange exactly 10 rounded-square app icons in a clean 2-row by 5-column grid. Each icon is the same size with consistent corner radius and subtle drop shadow. Add a single centered letter label beneath each icon, exactly A through J.

Icon concepts, exactly 10:
A: Cream monochrome icon with stacked 3D numerals 1, 2, and 3 standing on a circular pedestal, sculptural clay/plaster look.
B: Dark navy icon with four raised rounded number tiles, colored blue 7, cream 3, orange 5, and teal 8, arranged like playful puzzle blocks.
C: Deep purple-black icon with a large gradient numeral 9 in orange-to-magenta-to-violet, with colorful particle dots bursting from the right edge.
D: Dark teal icon showing an orbital logic pattern: concentric circular paths, small white spheres, and a glowing cyan center.
E: Warm ivory icon with flowing rainbow wave bands rising from left to right, small Fibonacci-like numbers above the wave: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21.
F: Dark indigo icon with a geometric network made of thin white connecting lines and dots, with a glowing golden center point like a constellation.
G: Dark teal icon with a luminous infinity loop made from many fine parallel lines, transitioning from cyan on the left to golden orange on the right.
H: Light cream icon with a 3x3 grid of tactile number tiles, numbers 2 4 7 on the top row, 1 5 6 in the middle, 8 3 9 on the bottom; the 5 tile is blue and the 7 and 8 tiles are dark.
I: Dark navy icon with a large glossy white 3D question mark, small colored buttons/dots on it, suggesting curiosity and puzzles.
J: Near-black icon with a circular color wheel or dial around a dark central disk, segmented rainbow colors, plus a small white sphere at the upper right edge.

Visual style: High-end app store icon exploration sheet, soft 3D rendering mixed with clean vector precision, rounded corners, realistic highlights, subtle ambient occlusion, crisp typography, balanced white space, no watermark.

Constraints: Keep the board uncluttered, preserve exactly 10 concepts and the A–J labels, avoid adding extra icons or explanatory text beyond the title, tagline, numbers inside icons, and labels.

Goal: Create a cozy overhead breakfast flat-lay photo with handwritten Japanese diary-style annotations, as if made for a warm morning social media post. The scene should feel realistic, softly edited, and slightly nostalgic.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape image, about 1024×576. Use a brown-and-white gingham tablecloth covering the full background, with soft morning light, gentle shadows, and a slightly warm film-like tone.

Main layout: Place exactly 2 main food/drink areas. On the left, a decorative red-and-white porcelain teacup filled with black coffee sits on a matching saucer. On the right, a large white square plate holds the breakfast foods. Leave darkened negative space in the upper left for the title handwriting.

Food and object count: Include exactly 7 visible breakfast items/props on the plate area: 1 stack of toasted bread slices, 1 partly peeled ripe banana, 1 small mound of granola, 1 clear glass bowl of pale yellow apple compote with 1 dark prune on top, 1 brown egg, 1 small wooden egg cup or wooden coaster behind the egg, and 1 white square plate. The toast should be the visual center of the plate, with golden toasted surfaces and thick white bread edges. The banana should be at the upper left of the plate. The egg should be at the upper right. The glass bowl should be at the lower right. The granola should sit between the toast and bowl.

Handwritten text and annotation count: Add exactly 9 handwritten annotation groups in white/black ink, with arrows, circles, small hearts, sparkles, and doodles. Preserve the Japanese text as decorative handwriting:
1. Large title at top left: 「わたしの整う朝ごはん。」
2. Subtitle under title: 「シンプルだけど、ちゃんと満たされる。」
3. Circular note near coffee: 「今日も はじまりは 深い一杯から。」
4. Small note below coffee: 「ほっと息をつく、大切な時間。」
5. Torn-paper sticky note at bottom left with pink tape: 「朝の光を浴びて、心もからだも ゆっくり目覚めていく。」
6. Note above banana with arrow: 「完熟バナナで やさしい甘みを チャージ。」
7. Bubble note beside egg: 「たんぱく質で 1日を すっきり スタート！」
8. Note near toast with arrow: 「サクッと焼けた トーストが 一番のごちそう。」
9. Lower-right notes around granola, compote, and overall feeling: 「ザクザクのグラノーラで 食感と栄養をプラス。」, 「りんごとプルーンで 自然な甘さを からだにやさしく。」, and 「ちゃんと食べると、心までふんわり軽くなる。」

Visual style: Photorealistic breakfast photography mixed with casual hand-drawn overlay graphics. Use white ink for most handwriting, black ink for food labels on the plate, dotted speech bubbles, curved arrows, tiny stars, small hearts, and playful underline marks. The typography should look hand-lettered, not digital. Make the annotations readable but naturally imperfect.

Customizable elements: The title should read {argument name="headline text" default="わたしの整う朝ごはん。"}; the drink should be {argument name="morning drink" default="black coffee in a red porcelain teacup"}; the main breakfast should feature {argument name="main breakfast food" default="thick golden toast"}; the fruit should be {argument name="fruit item" default="ripe banana and apple compote with prune"}; the overall mood should be {argument name="mood" default="gentle, cozy, mindful morning"}.

Constraints: Keep the composition clean and appetizing, do not add extra foods beyond the counted items, do not add people or hands, avoid logos or watermarks, and keep the Japanese handwriting integrated into the image like a real edited breakfast journal photo.

Using REFERENCE_0 as the base photo, retouch it into a clean, professional lifestyle shot while preserving the bouquet, clear glass vase, white ribbon text “JUST FOR YOU,” and the exact arrangement with 4 visible peach roses. Brighten the entire scene with warm natural sunlight coming through the window, improve exposure and color, make the greenery and roses look fresh and vivid, and add a soft shallow-depth-of-field look to the outdoor view. Neaten the composition by centering the vase and bouquet more elegantly, removing distracting table items such as the 2 gray placemats and dark chair backs, and making the tablecloth look freshly ironed, smoother, cleaner, and softly lit. Keep the window, sheer curtains, and cozy indoor setting, but make the result look polished, airy, and photorealistic, as if shot for a home decor or flower delivery advertisement.

Goal: Create a high-fashion character wardrobe concept board for a small child, titled around {argument name="section number" default="SECTION 42"}, with a calm museum-catalog / sci-fi archive aesthetic.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster on a warm ivory paper background with subtle grain, soft studio lighting, muted shadows, and lots of negative space. Use thin pale taupe linework to form a honeycomb of exactly 7 outlined hexagons: 1 large central hexagon and 6 surrounding wardrobe hexagons.

Layout: Place the central hexagon in the middle with a small geometric diamond emblem above widely spaced text reading {argument name="central title" default="SECTION 42"}. Surround it with exactly 6 labeled outfit panels: top center, upper left, upper right, lower left, lower right, and bottom center. Each outfit panel contains one full-body child mannequin/model on the left or center and exactly 4 small vertical material/detail swatches on the right. Keep the child’s face softly obscured/blurred and anonymous in every panel.

Subject: The same young child, about 5–7 years old, petite, with messy dark curly hair tied loosely back, neutral stance, realistic proportions, editorial fashion styling. Skin tone medium-light to tan, but face intentionally blurred. Render as a polished photorealistic fashion lookbook, not cartoonish.

Six wardrobe panels and exact contents:
1. Top center panel label: {argument name="top outfit label" default="RITUAL MOTION"}. Child wears a cropped cream wrap shirt, layered belts and waist pouch, loose olive harem trousers, wrist wraps, and beige strappy platform sandals. The 4 swatches show cream fabric, olive fabric, sandals, and rolled pouch/bag.
2. Upper left panel label: DISCIPLINE TRAINING. Child wears a rust-orange athletic crop top, black loose cropped training pants, red wrist wraps, and orange sneakers. The 4 swatches show orange fabric, red wrap coil, black fabric, and orange sneaker detail.
3. Upper right panel label: FIELD MAINTENANCE. Child wears dark denim overalls over a charcoal shirt, work gloves, rolled cuffs, and rugged brown boots. The 4 swatches show denim, worn denim detail, black gloves, and brown boots.
4. Lower left panel label: DEPTH EXPLORATION. Child wears a bulky dark vintage diving suit or deep-sea exploration outfit with round helmet, tubes, heavy gloves, utility details, and black boots. The 4 swatches show a brass porthole/helmet detail, mechanical suit texture, underwater silhouette scene, and black boot detail.
5. Lower right panel label: CEREMONY PRESENCE. Child wears an elegant flowing ivory ceremonial dress with draped sleeves, soft folds, simple necklace, and pale shoes. The 4 swatches show ivory draped fabric, sandy/beige texture, pendant necklace, and ivory fabric folds.
6. Bottom center panel label: WEEKEND UNWIND. Child wears an oversized red hockey jersey with the number 42 and a winged-wheel style crest, denim shorts, striped socks, and plush animal slippers. The 4 swatches show red-and-white jersey stripes, denim shorts, patterned sock, and plush duck slipper.

Typography: Use thin uppercase letter-spaced sans serif text in muted gray-brown. Panel labels are small and minimal, split over two lines where needed. Central text is larger with wide tracking: SECTION on one line and 42 below it.

Visual style: Minimal luxury editorial, archival wardrobe taxonomy, soft beige palette with muted olive, rust, denim blue, ivory, charcoal, and red accents. Photorealistic garments with tactile fabric detail, clean cutout presentation, soft shadows beneath each child, precise thin hexagon borders.

Constraints: Use exactly 6 full-body child figures, exactly 7 hexagons total, and exactly 24 swatch/detail rectangles total, 4 per outfit panel. No extra characters, no watermark, no dense body text, no bright background, no logos except the fictional jersey crest.

Create a square 1:1 comic-style meme infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="What is a World Model?"} in huge bold black lettering centered at the top on a white background. Below the title, draw a clean black-outlined 3-column by 3-row grid with an extra left label column, like a humorous taxonomy chart. Column headers across the top are exactly three: “Predicts”, “Simulates”, and “Breaks Your Brain”. Row labels down the left are exactly three: “Robots”, “Foundation Models”, and “Movie Night”. Use thick black grid lines, white cell backgrounds, and colorful hand-drawn cartoon illustrations with crisp outlines, resembling playful science/AI memes.

Cell 1, Robots × Predicts: title “DreamerV3”. Show a cute small robot sleeping on a blue pillow/blanket, with “Zzz” nearby and a thought bubble containing three small sequential robot/world prediction panels ending with a red flag.

Cell 2, Robots × Simulates: title “Tiny Sandbox”. Show a glass snow-globe terrarium on a wooden base with a tiny robot standing on grass beside a tree, clouds, birds, and a sun inside the dome.

Cell 3, Robots × Breaks Your Brain: title “Reward Goblin”. Show a small robot startled by a frantic green goblin chasing floating gold star rewards along a dotted path, with a red exclamation mark near the robot.

Cell 4, Foundation Models × Predicts: title “Autocomplete Earth”. Show a retro computer-like AI with a green smiling screen and robot arms hovering over a globe, with a thought bubble containing a weather icon, a newspaper labeled “NEWS”, and a smiling emoji.

Cell 5, Foundation Models × Simulates: title “Weather Wizard”. Show an old wizard in a blue robe and pointed hat casting spells over a world map or globe-like table, surrounded by weather icons: storm cloud with lightning, grey cloud, rain cloud, tornado, and bright sun, plus a small server rack at the side.

Cell 6, Foundation Models × Breaks Your Brain: title “Everything Machine”. Show a giant black top-hat-shaped machine labeled {argument name="machine label" default="FM"} with a flexible hose/tube, generating many outputs: a cloud, purple DNA strand, red car, small robot, and a document page.

Cell 7, Movie Night × Predicts: title “The Truman Show”. Show a man standing inside a transparent dome on a circular stage with a suburban house, fence, grass, clouds, and city skyline inside, surrounded by multiple studio cameras and spotlights outside the dome.

Cell 8, Movie Night × Simulates: title “The Matrix”. Show a person seated in a futuristic chair wearing a black outfit, plugged into cables, against falling green code, flanked by one red pill and one blue pill. Keep the face simplified or obscured.

Cell 9, Movie Night × Breaks Your Brain: title “SimCity God Mode”. Show a giant hand descending from a cloud and placing or pinching a building above a miniature city with roads, houses, factories, smoke, small people looking up with “?!” speech bubbles, and a bright sky.

Constraints: include exactly 9 illustrated content cells, exactly 3 column headers, exactly 3 row labels, and exactly the cell titles listed above. Keep all typography bold, legible, black, and meme-like. Use a polished cartoon infographic style, not photorealistic. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional panels.

Create a cinematic surreal photorealistic scene of a young man seen from behind, standing close to a dark wooden dresser and staring into a large ornate antique gold mirror. The real person is casually dressed in a plain {argument name="shirt color" default="faded blue-gray"} T-shirt, with short messy brown hair, his shoulders and back softly lit. In the mirror reflection, he appears transformed into a different adult man wearing a formal {argument name="reflected outfit" default="gray suit jacket, black vest, white dress shirt, and black bow tie"}; his reflected face is obscured by a square pixelated censor block and surrounded by subtle horizontal digital glitch artifacts, suggesting an identity swap or Freaky Friday body-swap moment. The room is a moody vintage bedroom with teal patterned wallpaper, framed paintings, a polished wooden vanity, small trinkets on the surface, and two warm table lamps glowing on either side, one reflected inside the mirror and one visible at the right edge. Use a vertical 3:4 composition, over-the-shoulder viewpoint, shallow depth of field, warm amber practical lighting mixed with cool green-blue shadows, film grain, dust specks, slight lens softness, and a mysterious psychological thriller atmosphere. The mirror should be the central focus, with elaborate carved baroque details at the top and bottom, realistic reflections, no readable text, no watermark.

Create a professional lifestyle fashion portrait of a stylish young woman leaning confidently against a dark polished marble building pillar in a luxurious modern urban city environment. She wears an elegant cream monochromatic outfit: an oversized tailored blazer draped open over her shoulders, a fitted cream cropped tank top, high-waisted wide-leg pleated trousers, and clean white low-top sneakers. Add delicate minimal jewelry including a small pendant necklace and bracelet, and have her hold one metallic stainless-steel water bottle at her side. Pose her relaxed with one shoulder against the glossy black marble wall, one arm bent with her hand resting near her waist, legs crossed casually at the ankles, looking toward the camera with calm confidence. Use a vertical full-body editorial fashion composition, natural daylight, warm reflections, shallow depth of field, softly blurred glass buildings and city walkway in the background, realistic skin and fabric texture, premium magazine street-style photography, 85mm lens look, high detail, no text, no watermark.

Transform the subject of the photo into a {argument name="item" default="toy-like figure"}. However, the person is depicted as a slightly exaggerated 3D character. Soft sculptural forms, matte textures, simplified geometry, cinematic clarity, and high visual polish. Keep the character recognizable while stylizing. Behind the figure, place a branded box printed with the attached image (the one before characterization). Place a circular pedestal in front of the box and have the figure sitting on it. Represent it in an {argument name="environment" default="indoor desk environment"}.

Convert this image into a soft, {argument name="style" default="handcrafted paper-cut layered illustration style"}, inspired by papercraft diorama aesthetics. Use smooth rounded shapes, simplified cute character proportions, and minimal facial details (dot eyes, blush cheeks) to create a warm, charming look. Apply stacked paper layers with visible depth, subtle shadows between layers, and clean cut edges that resemble laser-cut cardstock ++Add a distinct white outer outline layer surrounding each main character, resembling a thick sticker border or white cut-paper backing, clearly separating the characters from the background. This white layer should feel like an intentional paper layer, not a glow. Use a {argument name="colors" default="pastel color palette"} with muted blues, greens, and warm neutrals, balanced and calming. Lighting should feel soft, diffused, and even, enhancing the dimensional paper layers without harsh contrast. ++++ {argument name="textures" default="Textures should appear matte and tactile, like thick art paper or craft foam"}. Overall mood: cozy, wholesome, gentle, and storybook-like, with a playful yet polished handcrafted feel suitable for modern illustration, children’s books, or decorative art.

Antique portolan chart of {argument name="region" default="[REGION]"}, 15th-century style. Aged vellum, red/black/gold rhumb line network, hand-lettered Latin coast names, sea monsters, caravel ships, compass rose cartouche, gothic title scroll. 1:1.

Use the uploaded portrait only to preserve the person’s facial identity, hairstyle, hairline, skin tone, and natural presence. Design a realistic restaurant interior based on this menu: {argument name="menu" default="[menu]"}, matching the cuisine, price level, mood and target audience, cinematic interior photography.

[Core Requirements] A portrait of a person in a {argument name="clothing color" default="light pastel pink"} sleeveless top under the warm golden sunlight of late afternoon. Maintain realistic proportions.

[Person's Pose and Expression] [Person Reference Images 1-11] The subject is standing in {argument name="pose" default="profile"} with a dreamy and slightly sad gaze toward the camera. The person looks at the camera only with their eyes, with their head slightly lowered and turned. Hair naturally flutters around the face due to the wind blowing from behind.

[Hair and Makeup Details] A dark-haired bun style tied loosely at the back, but many strands of hair are naturally scattered over the face and neck. The makeup is transparent and clean, with a natural blush on the cheeks and lips in a moist, natural color. Fine beads of sweat are visible on the skin.

[Lighting and Direction] A warm and intense halo light enters through the hair from the center of the frame, wrapping the woman's hair and facial contours in a golden glow. Light reflects off the skin, giving it a sheen.

[Texture and Color Mood] A soft, dreamy atmosphere and graininess, as if shot with a film camera. Colors harmonize warm gold, green, and soft light blue. The fine texture of the skin and the cotton texture of the sleeveless clothing are felt.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth/Angle] Shallow depth of field makes the subject sharp while the background is softly blurred. Captured from the front in a medium close-up. A soft and warm depiction characteristic of old-fashioned film lenses.

[Background Elements (Optional)] Blurred green leaves are visible in the background.

[Signature] A small Threads logo (operated by Meta) is located in the bottom right, with "{argument name="signature" default="CHAse"}" written small like a signature in white cursive above it.

Create a white t-shirt product mockup (flat lay, front view, plain white background).

The t-shirt design uses black line art only. No color fill. No shading. White shirt throughout.

Illustration style: hand-drawn with a soft pencil or crayon. Lines are slightly wobbly and uneven, with inconsistent pressure — some strokes faint, some darker. Outlines do not always close perfectly. The overall impression is a casual, childlike sketch — imperfect but charming. Minimal detail. No clean vector lines. No digital precision.

The t-shirt has four printed zones:

TOP CENTER: Reproduce the festival logo from the first attached image exactly as-is — do not alter the font, layout, or graphic style in any way. Place it prominently at the top center of the shirt. Make it large enough to read clearly. Do NOT apply the hand-drawn or yuru-kyara style to this logo.

TOP RIGHT: A hand-drawn jagged speech bubble (spiky, explosive edges — like a shouting manga effect), slightly smaller than the character illustration. Inside the bubble, write "{argument name="dialogue" default="[Insert dialogue here]"}" in clumsy, uneven hand-lettered characters. The bubble and text should feel comic and energetic.

MIDDLE: Redraw the character from the attached image in a loose, casual, yuru-kyara style — simplified, childlike, charmingly imperfect. Use the attached image as the sole reference for pose, expression, and content. Draw the character smaller — occupying no more than 40% of the shirt's height. Leave generous white space around the figure. The speech bubble may overlap with the top portion of the character illustration. Do not shrink the character to avoid overlap.

BOTTOM: The artist name "{argument name="artist name" default="[Insert artist name here]"}" hand-lettered in uneven, shaky characters — as if written slowly and clumsily by hand with a pencil.

Keep all elements well-spaced and balanced. Clean, minimal, no background decoration.

Accurately maintain the atmosphere of the character as an anime illustration. Maintain the impression of the character's face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, ears, silhouette, proportions, and expression. Never break the character's identity. Do not turn them into a live-action human. The character part must maintain anime illustration expression. The setting is a realistic fast food restaurant or cafe drive-thru, reminiscent of a global chain. Realistic background depiction. A real-world space with a lived-in feel. Not too clean. Do not make it look like an advertisement photo. Naturally place menu signs, intercoms, paper bags, drink cups, kitchen equipment, lines of cars, greasy lighting, and realistic store facilities within the store and around the drive-thru. Perspective of a streamer live-streaming with a smartphone. POV composition shot from inside a car. Naturally frame-in the car window, steering wheel, drinks, dashboard, and side mirrors in the foreground. The person on the streamer's side is not holding up the smartphone, but is naturally reaching out to receive a product or paper bag. An anime character clerk in uniform is serving through the drive-thru window. The character is performing natural actions of 'working normally', such as handing over a paper bag, confirming an order, operating a cash register terminal, inserting a straw, or responding according to the manual with a blank expression or a slightly sleepy look. The surrounding world isn't completely surprised either, and there's an atmosphere like 'they just normally exist'. Add a live-stream style UI. Modern vertical live-stream UI like TikTok LIVE, YouTube Live, or Instagram Live. Naturally display a comment section, viewer count, LIVE indicator, likes, and gift notifications. Do not fix the comment content; let the AI generate it naturally. Emphasize a strangely realistic atmosphere where the live-action world and anime character are naturally fused. Add smartphone-like qualities such as light HDR processing, fine sensor noise, slight JPEG compression, natural exposure, minor chromatic aberration, auto-focus feel, slight camera shake, high ISO noise, live-stream specific highlights, and the unstable feel of handheld shooting. Do not make it look like a movie poster. No excessive cinematic production. No overly beautiful compositions. Avoid 'glossy rendering' typical of AI. Do not overload with information. Emphasize a sense of chance and daily life, like a 'mysterious live-stream clip posted on social media'. Emphasize an atmosphere typical of modern internet culture, where 'only the streamer's energy is a bit off'.

Create a unified page design with colors that match the character.
